email_subject: Application - Social Media Manager at Meta Endurance
email_body:
Hi Meta Endurance team,

I saw your Social Media Manager role and had to reach out. I'm a digital marketer who builds content that performs: I recently ran a self-funded Google Ads test for a kids' bike brand that earned a 4.57% CTR and 53 clicks, and I've built and launched a ~600-page site for a pharmacists' association. I also create visuals and copy for my own projects, like the PupSmart dog-care app on Google Play, so I'm comfortable producing content that fits a brand's DNA without needing a designer.

What draws me to Meta Endurance is your focus on running, cycling and triathlon. I'm an active athlete myself and I understand the gear-obsessed audience you serve. I'd love to help you grow your Instagram, YouTube and TikTok channels with content that resonates.

I live in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and have my own car, so travelling to events like UTMB or World Championships is no problem.

In the first weeks, I'd dive into your content calendar, identify trends and start producing visuals and copy that match your voice. Let's talk about how I can contribute.

Best,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
baverok.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok
cover_letter:
Dear Meta Endurance team,

When I saw your Social Media Manager opening, I knew I had to apply. I'm a digital marketer who doesn't just plan content—I produce it, test it, and measure what works. For a kids' bike brand, I built two Dutch landing pages, chose buyer-intent keywords, and ran a Google Ads test that earned a 4.57% CTR and 53 clicks. That same hands-on approach is what I'd bring to your Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok channels.

Your mission to serve the running, cycling, and triathlon community resonates with me. I'm an athlete myself, and I understand the passion and knowledge your audience expects. I've built and launched my own products, like the PupSmart dog-care app on Google Play, where I designed the visuals, wrote the copy, and managed the launch—all without a graphic designer. That experience means I can create content that fits your DNA and engages your community.

In my current role at Episto, I've built ~600 member profile pages for a pharmacists' association and helped a client rank #4 on Google Turkey for 'PDKS'. I also freelance, selling SEO and marketing automation services, which has taught me to take ownership of projects from start to finish. I'm comfortable analysing data in GA4 and Search Console to refine strategy, and I thrive on identifying trends and turning them into content.

I live in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and have my own car, so travelling to client events like UTMB or the World Championships is no problem. In the first weeks, I'd immerse myself in your content calendar, spot trends, and start producing visuals and copy that match your voice. I'd also work with your Community Manager to ensure every comment and question is answered in line with your brand.

I'd love to discuss how my skills can help Meta Endurance grow its social media presence. Let's talk.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

I am a digital marketer with a sales mindset who judges content by the audience it attracts and engages. At Episto I help client businesses rank for the searches their buyers make, from keyword research to technical SEO, and as a freelancer I bring in and scope my own clients. Years as a tango instructor in Türkiye taught me to work with people every day, build trust and take ownership of a whole studio. My start in front-end development means I can create visuals, run campaigns and read the data without waiting on anyone. Outside client work I build my own products with AI, from a dog-care app on Google Play to fitness trackers, which keeps me close to how real users find, try and stick with a product. I am analytical, I follow trends closely, and I am eager to learn.
